description: Parse duplicate-MAC detection and deletion evidence only. Preserve message, timestamp, service and existing tags. Adds network_aiops fields; does not alter indexes, retention, or remediation.
name: [POC] Nokia SR Linux MAC Flapping Evidence

grok.matchRules:
detected_interface bridgetable[|]%{integer:network_aiops.pid}[|]%{integer:network_aiops.thread_id}[|]%{integer:network_aiops.sequence}[|]N: A duplicate MAC address %{macaddr:network_aiops.mac} was detected on sub-interface %{notSpace:network_aiops.interface}[.]
detected_instance bridgetable[|]%{integer:network_aiops.pid}[|]%{integer:network_aiops.thread_id}[|]%{integer:network_aiops.sequence}[|]N: A duplicate MAC address %{macaddr:network_aiops.mac} was detected on %{notSpace:network_aiops.network_instance}[.]
deleted_interface bridgetable[|]%{integer:network_aiops.pid}[|]%{integer:network_aiops.thread_id}[|]%{integer:network_aiops.sequence}[|]N: A duplicate MAC address %{macaddr:network_aiops.mac} detected on sub-interface %{notSpace:network_aiops.interface} is now deleted[.]
deleted_instance bridgetable[|]%{integer:network_aiops.pid}[|]%{integer:network_aiops.thread_id}[|]%{integer:network_aiops.sequence}[|]N: A duplicate MAC address %{macaddr:network_aiops.mac} detected on %{notSpace:network_aiops.network_instance} is now deleted[.]
